name: Francisco Assis - § 78 - Am 16
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 78. Is concerned that the Digital Services Act (DSA) is being used to introduce a pan-European censorship regime, and to decide what can or cannot circulate on social media; considers that this development undermines legitimate democratic discourse and suppresses free speech; views the imposition by the Commission of a EUR 120 million fine on the X as an example of the enforcement of the EU censorship regime and warns that the DSA risks censoring global speech; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 9 Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 19 October 2022 on a Single Market For Digital Services and amending Directive 2000/31/EC (Digital Services Act) (OJ L 277, 27.10.2022, p. 1, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2022/2065/oj).
